_file_info.purpose: Reproducible local-texture audit around the selected Neuro injection carrier.

window.token_definition: Unicode word or individual non-whitespace punctuation token (regex \w+|[^\w\s])

metrics.citation_marker_definition: Bracketed numeric citations, 19xx/20xx years, et al., numbered reference-line starts, DOI labels, and doi.org links

interpretation: The clean and injected source neighborhoods have identical document-texture counts once the declared payload is removed; the payload adds no math/LaTeX-like characters or citation markers under these definitions. Cross-domain texture rates can still confound a pooled probe.
